title: A Space with a physical location runs Regulars: a check-in at its door code stamps a card, pays 25 Zaps, and a full card earns the reward the owner set

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-10-19 ('I want a Space to be able to take part in the loyalty / check in program if they have a physical location... the space owner to be able to set the reward value and the individual checking in gets 25 zaps'). docs/LOYALTY.md, ADR-1780

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-19. Phase 1 of Regulars (docs/LOYALTY.md). Migration 20270346010200 adds space_loyalty_programs, loyalty_stamps, loyalty_rewards, the loyalty_record_visit RPC (advisory lock per card, mints the reward when the card fills) and the zap_config row space_checkin (25, daily cap 75). lib/engagement/capture.ts calls recordLoyaltyVisit after the ledger accepts a Space check-in for the member's day. The owner edits the program inside the Check-in panel (reward, value, visits, welcome stamps, geofence) and hands rewards out by code; the member sees the card on the check-in result and at /rewards. Gate: a mappable location and a plan at or above Business (loyaltyEligibility); LOYALTY_ENABLED is the launch switch (RUNBOOKS). The door link written to an NFC tag is the tap check-in. Hunts are LIVE-941, the psychology layer LIVE-942, discovery LIVE-943, event tap LIVE-944, Tap to meet LIVE-945.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const miss=[];if(!/create or replace function public\.loyalty_record_visit/.test(r('supabase/migrations/20270346010200_space_loyalty.sql')))miss.push('no loyalty_record_visit migration');if(!/recordLoyaltyVisit\(node\.space_id/.test(r('lib/engagement/capture.ts')))miss.push('a Space check-in does not stamp the card');if(!/awardZapsForAction\(profileId, 'space_checkin'\)/.test(r('lib/loyalty/visit.ts')))miss.push('a check-in does not pay space_checkin Zaps');if(!/space_checkin: 25/.test(r('lib/zaps.ts')))miss.push('space_checkin is not 25 Zaps');if(!/loyaltyEligibility/.test(r('lib/loyalty/store.ts'))||!/isMappable/.test(r('lib/loyalty/store.ts')))miss.push('no physical-location gate');if(!/RegularsSection/.test(r('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/checkin/section.tsx')))miss.push('the owner has no Regulars panel');if(!/listMyLoyaltyCards/.test(r('app/(main)/rewards/page.tsx')))miss.push('members have no /rewards page');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-940: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
